graph.about: Repository map for AI agents. Paths are repo-relative with forward slashes. Nodes: "file:<path>" is one file; coverage "listed" means it was only seen in a listing or search, so its contents are unknown. "symbol:<path>#<Qualified.Name>" is one declaration in that file, with kind, source_location (L<start>-L<end>), signature and summary when recorded. Edges: contains (file -> symbol -> member), calls, imports, inherits, implements, instantiates; confidence EXTRACTED = seen, INFERRED = guessed (confidence_score), AMBIGUOUS = unclear. To find a function, match the part after "#" or the label, then open source_file at source_location. Follow calls edges both ways for callers and callees. A missing node does not mean missing code: only files an agent opened are mapped. Paths ignored by .gitignore, the default directories and agent tooling are never mapped.
